audit_scope: browser -> deployed frontend -> deployed API -> PostgreSQL/external provider

findings.summary: Configured production backend https://otravelz-backend.onrender.com is completely unreachable
findings.detail: Probes to https://otravelz-backend.onrender.com/health time out (>90s). Render free-tier service has either hibernated without recovering, been suspended, or deleted. Deployed clients cannot reach any remote API.
findings.remediation: Document exact status; provide production deployment instructions and verify standalone local/staging container runtime.

findings.summary: All documented production frontend URLs return 404 or DNS failures
findings.detail: https://o-travelz.onrender.com returns HTTP 404. https://algoryxz.github.io/O-Travelz/ returns HTTP 404. https://otravelz.in has no DNS records. remote origin/gh-pages branch contains legacy pre-V4 build (commit 51ab34ed). Web V4 is not live on any remote host.
findings.remediation: Document actual deployed state; verify production static bundle (dist/) via local/isolated production preview; update deployment workflow.

findings.detail: The GitHub Pages workflow executes 'npm run build' without passing VITE_API_URL. Any deployment generated by this workflow defaults to same-origin relative API requests, which return 404 on GitHub Pages.
findings.remediation: Configure VITE_API_URL in workflow environment variables or document requirement.

findings.summary: CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env restricts to unresolvable domains (otravelz.in)
findings.detail: backend/.env specifies CORS_ORIGINS=https://otravelz.in,https://www.otravelz.in. Neither domain resolves in DNS. If frontend is accessed from GitHub Pages or Render, requests are blocked by CORS.
findings.remediation: Include deployed origins (e.g. https://algoryxz.github.io, https://o-travelz.onrender.com) in allowed origins.

findings.detail: frontend/vercel.json contains only a wildcard SPA rewrite to /index.html. If deployed on Vercel without an external API URL, API calls are captured by SPA rewrite and return HTML instead of JSON.
findings.remediation: Add API proxy rewrites or document external VITE_API_URL requirement for Vercel.

findings.summary: GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI points to dead domain api.otravelz.in
findings.detail: OAuth callback URI is hardcoded to https://api.otravelz.in/auth/google/callback, which cannot resolve in DNS.
findings.remediation: Align redirect URI with actual deployed backend domain.

findings.detail: getApiBaseUrl() gracefully normalizes trailing slashes, protocol prefixes, and defaults to relative paths for same-origin or reverse-proxied setups.
findings.remediation: Retain as single source of truth.

findings.summary: base: './' in frontend/vite.config.ts enables portability across any static host
findings.detail: Generates relative assets that function seamlessly whether mounted at domain root or nested subpaths.

findings.summary: Hosted PostgreSQL database is healthy, migrated, and populated with 100% verified data
findings.detail: Aiven PostgreSQL 16 with PostGIS 3.4 is operational and responds with zero errors.

findings.summary: Live weather service operates without external API keys or paid tiers
findings.detail: Endpoint https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast provides live weather and fails closed when out-of-bounds.
